item.name: Abyssal Cannon
entries: A heavy cannon with a magical tentacle stitched to its interior. The tentacle can grasp forward in order to grapple and pull creatures.
You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Alternate Attack
entries: This weapon has an alternate attack. When you attack with this weapon, you can substitute an attack with the alternate attack. Alternate attacks can't trigger Mastery.

entries.name: Alternate Attack: Grasp of the Deep
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft. {@h}Hit: {@damage 1d8} Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is pulled until it is within 5 feet of you and is Grappled by the weapon's tentacle. If the target is Large or larger, you can pull yourself toward the target until you are within 5 feet of it.
Using an Alternate Attack or making an attack with this weapon against a creature that has not been Grappled by it releases the creature currently Grappled by the weapon.

entries.name: Alternate Attack (1/Day): Coral Strike
entries: A massive cluster of coral forms inside the cannon and is propelled outward by the tentacle. The cluster flies toward a point within 60 feet of you and shatters on impact. Each creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d6} Piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Mastery: Push
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

item.name: Chaos Magnum
entries: A revolver imbued with a magical, multicolored Wild Magic Crystal.
You can use this item as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Arcane Imbued
entries: While holding this gun, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of spells you cast with it.

entries.name: Wild Shot
entries: As a Magic action, you can use the magical powers of the gun to fire a chaos bullet and cause a random effect. Roll a {@dice d10} to determine the effect.

entries.caption: Wild Shot Effects
rows: The barrel explodes. You take {@damage 1d6} Fire damage.

entries: This item uses the bearer's Intelligence as its spellcasting ability, and it always casts a spell or cantrip at its lowest level.

entries.name: Additional Chaos Bullets
entries: At levels 5, 10, and 15, you gain the ability to fire one additional chaos bullet as part of the same action. To fire an additional chaos bullet, roll the {@dice d10} again for each bullet.

spell.name: Banishment
entries: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration, leaving an rift on the creature's position. While there, the target can't hold {@status Concentration|XPHB} on spells.

The demiplane has a dimensional lock that blocks its rift entry point, the dimensional lock has 60 hit points and is visible both inside and outside the demiplane, creatures can damage the lock on both sides but the lock has resistance to all damage recieved from outside; if the lock reaches 0 hit points, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
The dimensional lock can be targeted by any spell or ability that deals damage, it is immune to all conditions and has 10 AC and a -1 mod in all ability scores.
If the target belongs to a different plane of existence, the target takes {@damage 4d10} force damage when it starts it's turn inside the demiplane.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The dimentional lock hit points increases by 15 and the damage by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 4.

subclass.name: Path of the Wild Heart
subclassFeatures: Path of the Wild Heart|Barbarian|XPHB|Wild Heart|MatucksPlayerAdditions|3

subclassFeature.name: Path of the Wild Heart
entries: Barbarians who follow the Path of the Wild Heart view themselves as kin to animals. These Barbarians learn magical means to communicate with animals, and their Rage heightens their connection to animals as it fills them with supernatural might.

subclassFeature.name: Animal Speaker
entries: You can cast {@spell Beast Sense} and {@spell Speak with Animals}, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.

subclassFeature.name: Rage of the Wilds
entries: Your Rage taps into the primal power of animals. Whenever you activate your Rage, you gain one of the following animal forms of your choice. As a Bonus Action while your Rage is active, you can expend another use of your Rage to change to a different animal form.

entries.name: Bear
entries: While your Rage is active, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.

entries.name: Eagle
entries: When you activate your Rage, you can take the Dash and Disengage actions as part of that Bonus Action. While your Rage is active, you can take a Bonus Action to take both of those actions.

entries.name: Wolf
entries: While your Rage is active, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you.
Additionally, you gain Blindsight with a range of 30 feet that relies on hearing and smell.

subclassFeature.name: Animal Friend
entries: You can cast {@spell Animal Friendship} once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

subclassFeature.name: Aspect of the Wilds
entries: You gain one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choice.

entries.name: Owl
entries: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.

entries.name: Panther
entries: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

entries.name: Salmon
entries: You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

subclassFeature.name: Anger of the Wilds
entries: You add the following options to your animal forms.

entries.name: Lion
entries: While your Rage is active, creatures within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian with this option active.

entries.name: Snake
entries: When you activate your Rage, you create an ethereal snake around yourself and gain immunity to the {@condition Grappled} condition.

As part of that Bonus Action, you can attempt to Grapple a creature. The target must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (DC equals 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the {@condition Grappled} condition.
While your Rage is active, you can take a Bonus Action to attempt another Grapple.
The snake can maintain a grapple for you, leaving your hands free.

subclassFeature.name: Nature Speaker
entries: You can cast {@spell Commune with Nature}, but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

subclassFeature.name: Power of the Wilds
entries: You add the following options to your animal forms.

entries.name: Falcon
entries: While your Rage is active, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed while you aren't wearing armor.

entries.name: Ram
entries: While your Rage is active, when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can either knock it {@condition Prone} or push it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

entries.name: Forest Spirit
entries: While your Rage is active, you gain the effects of {@spell Conjure Animals}. The conjured pack can't move farther than 30 feet away from you. If you move in a way that would exceed this range, the pack is pulled toward you until it is within range.
Additionally, while your Rage is active, you no longer need to expend uses of Rage to change between animal forms.
